purpose: S0 golden fixture: minimal graph construction + query semantics, taken from observed upstream test behavior (crates/codegraph/tests/unit/graph_ops_test.rs at the locked SHA). Validated against UKMA S1 by a Rust golden test.

ukma_s1_expectations.edge_between: exactly one Calls edge from first node to second node

legitimate_expected_differences: IDs: upstream NodeId/EdgeId are vendor-internal u64 monotonic counters; UKMA canonical IDs MUST be stable across adapter substitution and MUST NOT reuse the vendor counters as external IDs (S1 rule). The fixture's 'id == 0' assertions bind to upstream semantics only.
ACL: upstream graph has no ACL/tenant layer; UKMA S1 traversal MUST filter by AuthContext before returning nodes/edges, so UKMA results may be a filtered subset for unauthorized scopes.
Errors: upstream uses thiserror Result types; UKMA maps them to the v1.2.3 ErrorContract codes (e.g. NotFound / Conflict / CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE).
Backend: upstream default feature is rocksdb-backend (KV trait + RocksDB impl); UKMA keeps RocksDB as an optional adapter behind the Storage Port — no SDK import in Domain crates.
Properties: upstream PropertyMap is untyped key-value; UKMA preserves the property bag but versioned schema validation applies at the boundary.
